dialogue.speaker: Ambrose Quill
dialogue.text: Between us, I've been alphabetizing the case files in the town office. Mine is filed under 'Q, pending.' Eleven years.

dialogue.speaker: Ambrose Quill
dialogue.text: I suspect it's a clerical error. I like to think it means someone up there forgot me on purpose, and is saving my seat.

dialogue.speaker: Ambrose Quill
dialogue.text: You've been kind to an old man who talks too much. I won't forget it.
